ValidationRule.description: Ensures the Disposition is required when a case status is updated from Legal to Closed, and that the Investigation has a Status of Recommend to Close. Also checks that all Case Contacts have an Allegation, and that all Allegations have a Violation.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Populate Disposition, Case Contacts have Allegations with Allegations Violations and Legal Actions, Investigation is "Recommend Referral to Legal" and Legal Investigation is "Recommend Warning Letter" or "Recommend to Close" or "Recommend to Settlement" .
